title: Visit cadence of Prescriptions & Renewals controlled fills under a new agreement
content:
**Medication Management Office standard — Prescriptions & Renewals controlled prescriptions.**

**1. The visit-cadence allowance.** When the patient signs a new controlled-substance agreement, the visit-cadence allowance spaces the fills to the patient's next visit with the prescribing department, using the latest-dated visit with that department that is booked or confirmed: where that visit is 1 to 60 calendar days after the signing day, the days to that visit are divided into the fewest fills of no more than the class's largest days' supply per fill, and the allowance is the days to the visit divided by that number of fills, rounded down to a whole day; where no visit with that department is booked or confirmed within 60 days but the latest completed in-person visit with it was fewer than 183 days before the signing day, the days remaining until 183 days after that visit are divided the same way; otherwise it allows the starting 14 days.

**2. Definitions.**
2.1 *Visits* are the patient's In-Person Appointments with the department of the prescriber on this prescription. The visit used for the first branch is the one with the latest scheduled date among those recorded as booked or confirmed. A virtual visit is not an in-person visit.
2.2 *Days to the visit* — the number of calendar days by which that visit's date falls after the signing day.
2.3 *Within 60 days* — the first branch applies only when the latest-dated booked or confirmed visit is 1 to 60 days after the signing day; otherwise the second branch is examined.
2.4 *Days remaining until 183 days after that visit* — 183 less the calendar days since the latest completed in-person visit.
2.5 *The fewest fills* — the smallest whole number of fills that, each at the class's largest days' supply per fill, cover the days; the days are then divided by that number of fills and any fraction of a day is dropped.

**3. Worked cases (hypothetical; the class's largest days' supply per fill taken as 30 days).**

| Situation on the signing day | Days to divide | Fewest fills | Visit-cadence allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| confirmed visit 45 days later | 45 | 2 | 22 days |
| booked visit 60 days later | 60 | 2 | 30 days |
| booked visit 20 days later | 20 | 1 | 20 days |
| booked visit 61 days later; last completed in-person visit 150 days before | 33 | 2 | 16 days |
| nothing booked; last completed in-person visit 183 days before | — | — | 14 days |
| nothing booked; no completed in-person visit | — | — | 14 days |
